what: Compute diffs between text strings — diff_make
title: Compute diffs between text strings — diff_make
text: following functions used construct work diff(s) text strings. Specifically, diff_make() computes character level differences source string (x) destination string (y). diffs can made human friendly via secondary cleaning process via cleanup argument. computed, diffs represented using diff_df data frames, consist just two columns: text op. Basic convenience functions pretty printing provided package. following helper functions provided: print() - prints diff using ANSI colors available. .character() - converts diff (using ANSI colors available) character vector. diff_levenshtein() calculates Levenshtein distance diff. diff_to_delta() converts diff delta string. diff_from_delta() creates diff source string (x) delta string. diff_to_html() converts diff pretty HTML string. diff_to_patch() converts diff patch string. diff_text_source() recovers source string diff. diff_text_dest() recovers destination string diff.

title: Compute diffs between text strings — diff_make
code: diff_make(x, y, cleanup = "semantic", checklines = TRUE)  diff_levenshtein(diff)  diff_to_delta(diff)  diff_from_delta(x, delta)  diff_to_html(diff)  diff_to_patch(diff)  diff_text_source(diff)  diff_text_dest(diff)

title: Compute diffs between text strings — diff_make
text: x source string y destination string cleanup Determines cleanup method applied diffs. Allowed values include: semantic, lossless, efficiency, merge none. See Details behavior methods. checklines Performance flag - FALSE, run line-level diff first identify changed areas. TRUE, run faster slightly less optimal diff. Default: TRUE. diff diff_df data frame. delta delta string.

title: Compute diffs between text strings — diff_make
text: diff_make() returns diff_df data frame containing diffs. diff_make() returns Levenshtein distance integer. diff_to_delta() returns character string. diff_from_delta() returns diff_df data frame. diff_to_html() returns character string. diff_to_patch() returns character string. diff_text_source() returns character string. diff_text_dest() returns character string.

title: Compute diffs between text strings — diff_make
text: semantic - Reduce number edits eliminating semantically trivial equalities. semantic lossless - Look single edits surrounded sides equalities can shifted sideways align edit word boundary. e.g: cat came. -> **cat **came. efficiency - Reduce number edits eliminating operationally trivial equalities. merge - Reorder merge like edit sections.  Merge equalities. edit section can move long cross equality. none - apply cleanup methods diffs.

title: Compute diffs between text strings — diff_make
code: (d = diff_make("abcdef", "abchij")) #> abcdefhij diff_levenshtein(d) #> [1] 3 diff_to_html(d) #> [1] "abcdefhij" diff_text_source(d) #> [1] "abcdef" diff_text_dest(d) #> [1] "abchij" diff_to_patch(d) #> [1] "@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@ abc -def +hij " (delta = diff_to_delta(d)) #> [1] "=3 -3 +hij" diff_from_delta("abcdef", delta) #> abcdefhij

title: diffmatchpatch settings — dmp_options
text: diff_timeout (float) - Number seconds map diff giving (0 infinity). diff_edit_cost (int) - Cost empty edit operation terms edit characters. match_threshold (float) - point match declared (0.0 = perfection, 1.0 = loose). match_distance (int) - far search match (0 = exact location, 1000+ = broad match). match many characters away expected location add 1.0 score (0.0 perfect match). patch_delete_threshold (float) - deleting large block text (~64 characters), close contents match expected contents. (0.0 = perfection, 1.0 = loose).  Note Match_Threshold controls closely end points delete need match. patch_margin (int) - Chunk size context length. match_max_bits (int) - number bits int.

what: Fuzzy matching of a text string — match_find
title: Fuzzy matching of a text string — match_find
text: Locate best instance pattern text near loc using Bitap algorithm.Returns -1 match found. Assumes R's typical 1-based indexing loc returned value. algorithm makes use match_distance match_threshold options determine match. values set explicitly via threshold distance arguments - value use currently set global option value. Candidate matches scored based : ) number spelling differences pattern text b) distance candidate match expected location. match_distance option determines relative importance two metrics.

title: Fuzzy matching of a text string — match_find
code: match_find(text, pattern, loc = 1L, threshold = NULL, distance = NULL)

title: Fuzzy matching of a text string — match_find
text: text text search. pattern pattern search . loc expected location pattern. threshold Threshold determining match (0 - perfect match, 1 - loose). distance Distance expected location scaling score penalty.

text: Index best match -1 match.

title: diffmatchpatch 0.2.0
text: Updated diff_match_patch.h upstream fix buffer overflow line mode diffs 127 unique lines, crash R (leutloff/diff-match-patch-cpp-stl#19). Fixed incorrect line mode diffs 255 unique lines. number line codes now capped remaining text treated single line, following approach used diff-match-patch implementations. Added testthat test suite, cases ported upstream test harness.
